messages:
amelia: Quick heads-up — posted the INC-912 postmortem. We still have a handful of open actions that need cross-team owners and concrete due dates before I close the RCA tracker. TL;DR: KV migration overlapped canary + cache invalidation edge case caused failover.
sanjay: I can take the 'KV migration rollback guard' (action 3). tentative due Thu 2024-06-20. I'll open a PR and tag reviewers.
mika: I'll own 'circuit-breaker + retry backoff' (action 5). putting due date Fri 2024-06-21. will coordinate with oncall for test window.
jonah: Quick q — does action 1 (serving config patch) need Dedicated team signoff? it's blocking a few things on infra side.
carol: tagging @kevin to confirm who owns the serving config change.
kevin: kevin: I can handle the serving config change, but it'll need a 2h maintenance window. target Mon 2024-06-24 morning UTC. I also need the exact list of routes to change.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra-canary v2 at 2024-06-20T02:00Z (manual) — reminder
amelia: Two asks: (1) owners please reply with a short 'ack' + due date; (2) if your action depends on another team, mention the team and the blocking PR/ticket. I'll compile into the tracker.
sanjay: ack — action 3 — due 2024-06-21 — depends on eng-platform PR #4567 (in review).
mika: ack — action 5 — due 2024-06-23 — depends on eng-oncall to approve canary window.
jonah: Action 1 will need eng-runtime to merge the small patch. @lila can you take runtime review? it's 4 lines in the routing layer.
lila: lila: ack — will take runtime patch review, ETA Wed 2024-06-19. tiny change, should be quick.
carol: also adding a note — we should draft a 1-page rollback playbook and attach it to the RCA doc. I can draft it by tomorrow.
kevin: also filing a follow-up to update alert thresholds for the KV miss spikes — ticket TICK-221.
amelia: Perfect. I'll update the RCA tracker with: owner, due, dependent team, PR/ticket links. If anyone can't meet the due, flag it here so we can reassign.
mika: small Q — do we need to backfill metrics for the affected window? that impacts the regression alerts and the quality monitoring.
jonah: yes — eng-telemetry should backfill the window. cc @sara for the job.
sara: sara: ack — will run the backfill job Fri 2024-06-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. adding to my calendar and the runbook.
amelia: Thanks. Last thing — who will be on a rapid rollback call if we need to act during cutover? please list names and timezones if relevant.
kevin: kevin: I'll be the oncall lead for rollback. adding @sanjay + @lila to the pager rotation for that window.
sanjay: sanjay: available for rollback.
lila: lila: available.
devops-bot: Note: incident channel will be archived when RCA doc status -> closed.
amelia: Great — I will close the loop in the tracker at 18:00 PT today (1763553600). If due dates shift, ping me directly or drop an updated ack here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
